title: Implement the place state machine and stable URL contract
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
state.ts, routes.ts, and location-state.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.

The machine does not resolve coordinates to a city, contact a GeoIP provider, or request device permission. Those are later tasks. A late GeoIP or device response is only admitted while no URL, manual, or saved choice is active.
A country-only suggestion cannot select a city. Multiple border candidates stay unresolved until the visitor chooses.
Browser language and timezone can suggest a UI language. They do not select a place or a legal date.
Search text can propose a place change. It does not replace the active place until that proposal is accepted.
Default shared links omit latitude, longitude, and street addresses. An explicit opt-in may add lat and lon. Addresses are never put on a shared link.
A coordinate pair or country code in the place parameter is not a place id. No city is invented from it, and a later suggestion cannot fill that gap.
The legacy public token netherlands migrates to place:netherlands. Documented Dutch migration targets keep place=netherlands. New shared links use the stable place id.
Publisher links on wetten.overheid.nl stay beside /#/law/<record-id>. The application route does not replace them. A date in a publisher path is not treated as the legal as-of date.
The three bundled sample CIDs migrate to partial coverage for the Netherlands. They are not presented as the published corpus.
Saved places store the stable id, label, civil date, and scope. Coordinate fields in a saved record are ignored.
A malformed link does not clear an existing place or date.
node_modules was absent and was installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts so Jest could run. package.json and package-lock.json were not edited.
CI=1 was set so Jest would not enter watch mode. The argv is the task command.

The Jest reporter and the existing Node NO_COLOR and VM Modules warnings were written to stderr, along with the ts-jest isolatedModules deprecation warning. stderr was not empty. The process exit code was 0.
The reporter counted 18 passing tests. One is the existing setup test. Seventeen exercise this place machine and URL contract.
This module does not decide that a law applies.
